headline: President Clinton created a commission focused on fairness in how educational resources are shared among schools.
what_it_does: This order set up a presidential commission on educational resource equity. Based on the title, the commission's job was likely to study gaps in school resources and advise the President. No summary was provided, so its exact duties, members, and deadlines are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: They were the likely subject of the commission's study of how educational resources are distributed.
They may have been involved in supporting or serving on the commission.
